channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: The 6 biggest chain-restaurant food trends of 2025 — and 3 that won't survive 2026
item.description: From chicken tenders to value meal deals, these big food trends dominated chain restaurants in 2025, though we predict some will be out in 2026.

item.title: The risks of 'ghost vacationing' over the holidays
item.description: Ghost vacationing and quiet quitting on Slack during the holidays can harm trust, team morale, and long-term workplace relationships.

item.title: Here are the most powerful news photos of the year
item.description: The most powerful news photos taken by Getty Images photographers in 2025 captured political unrest, natural disasters, and other major news events.

item.title: I found a delicious, easy way to elevate store-bought ravioli. This 20-minute recipe is my new cozy weeknight go-to.
item.description: Ree Drummond's cacio e pepe ravioli recipe has just a few ingredients and comes together quickly. I tried it, and now, it's my favorite easy dinner.

item.title: The hottest amenity in ultra-luxury buildings isn't the spa — it's a private restaurant downstairs
item.description: Luxury condos are offering resident-only dining as an exclusive amenity for added privacy and convenience.

item.title: Read the pitch decks of 14 startups looking to disrupt advertising and marketing with AI
item.description: Check out the pitch decks AI-powered advertising and marketing tech startups used to raise millions from venture capital firms.

item.title: I ditched mom life for 48 hours to see the Backstreet Boys in Vegas. It was one of the best decisions I've ever made.
item.description: I left my kids — including a newborn — to see the Backstreet Boys in August. They're back at the Sphere, and I hope another mom is doing the same.

item.title: I rang in 2025 on a solo trip. Now, I'd happily celebrate every New Year's Eve abroad and surrounded by strangers.
item.description: Celebrating New Year's Eve on a solo trip to a new place, surrounded by strangers, set a positive tone for the year and reminded me I wasn't alone.

item.title: I moved from Spain to Florida 21 years ago. My first marriage fell apart, but I met the love of my life.
item.description: I moved across the world for my husband and ended up a single mom. Years later, I met the love of my life when I least expected it.

item.title: China is going after US defense firms and execs over weapons sales to Taiwan — and Palmer Luckey's on the list
item.description: China's foreign ministry said the sanctioned firms and individuals would have their assets within China frozen.
